rows.title: Review: ‘The Killing of a Sacred Deer’ Depicts Familiar Torment
rows.comment: Lanthimos is less interested in moral shock therapy or social criticism than in aesthetic estrangement
rows.verdict_le10: Lanthimos is less interested in moral shock therapy or social criticism than in aesthetic estrangement
rows.dek_lead: Lanthimos is less interested in moral shock therapy or social criticism than in aesthetic estrangement. “Sacred Deer” feels like a dark, opaque bit of folklore transplanted into an off-kilter modern setting.

rows.comment: With uniformly great performances throughout the cast and Lanthimos’ stunning eye for detail and composition

rows.dek_lead: With uniformly great performances throughout the cast and Lanthimos’ stunning eye for detail and composition, this is one of the most unforgettable films of the year.
